experiment: btt_reward_v3_t2 (arm T, fresh models) versus the historical Phase K control (arm C, btt_reward_v2); btt_policy_obs_v1, btt_s9_b8_v1, PPO as Phase K, N=5 standby, 3,600-tick horizon, tick-0 starts, no curriculum, 3,072,000 policy transitions per run, seeds 0-2
authority: proposal docs/rl_target2_m7k.md section 10 (the M7k registration of btt_reward_v3_t2, canonical sha256 fa74d7d7edf88936fcb63e1c65cc5751dddc0bc6b1c974a70af232160b9def99); user authorization 2026-09-25 (primary rule, L and R, the separately recorded quantities). This file fixes the exact denominators, aggregation and tie handling and is read by rl/m7l_analysis.py
status: registered before the control check and before any campaign run; applied once at n = 3; never re-decided; no extension, no extra seed
arithmetic: exact integers and rationals (fractions.Fraction); no rounding anywhere; every comparison is inclusive exactly as written ('>=' / '<='); outcomes are decided by boolean gates, so no tie-breaking is needed

C.description: historical Phase K v1 control, reward btt_reward_v2
C.runs: runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1 (final checkpoints and their registered Phase K evaluations), reused only while the control check passes on the frozen campaign code

T.description: btt_reward_v3_t2 = btt_reward_v3 unchanged + a one-time moving-target credit 2.0 * (3600 - n) / 3600 on native target ID 2 (n = consumed_tick + 1)
T.runs: runs/m7l/campaign/m7l_t2_s{0,1,2}, fresh untrained models, trained in the order s0, s1, s2

pairing: by seed number (T seed s against C seed s)

evaluation_basis.primary_population: the 100 final stochastic evaluation episodes per seed and arm (Phase K protocol: seed 12345, frozen statistics, tick-0 starts only)
evaluation_basis.pooled_population: the 300 final stochastic episodes of an arm (3 seeds x 100)
evaluation_basis.denominators: every counted episode, whatever its end (horizon, fall, clear); excess episodes the evaluator did not count are never included
evaluation_basis.metrics: btt_eval_metrics_v1 with SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1 (native target identity and first-break consumed ticks)
evaluation_basis.deterministic: the 100 final deterministic episodes are reported (L, R, target 2, collapse) and never gate the primary rule; they count only for verified clears

definitions.broken(e): the native target IDs broken in episode e (btt_eval_metrics_v1 broken_ids; first-break consumed ticks from first_break_tick)
definitions.t2(e): 1 iff native target ID 2 is in broken(e), at any tick, whatever the episode's end
definitions.tick_i(e): the consumed tick of the first break of target i in e
definitions.t2[a][s]: sum of t2(e) over the 100 final stochastic episodes of arm a, seed s
definitions.p[a][s]: t2[a][s] / 100 (a percentage point is exactly one episode)
definitions.static(e): |broken(e) minus {2}|: every static target (right and left), all targets except the moving target 2
definitions.static_right(e): |broken(e) intersected with {0,3,4,5,7,9}| (the six static right targets; used by L, reported)
definitions.Sbar[a]: (sum of static(e) over the 300 pooled final stochastic episodes of arm a) / 300
definitions.L(e): 1 iff t2(e) and tick_2(e) <= 2699 and static_right(e) >= 5 (the five static right targets may break at any tick of the episode)
definitions.R(e): 1 iff all seven right IDs {0,2,3,4,5,7,9} are broken and max over them of tick_i(e) <= 2699 (at least 900 ticks left)
definitions.L[a][s], R[a][s]: sums over the 100 final stochastic episodes
definitions.verified clear: a native clear whose Phase K clear verification (tick-0 replay in a fresh process) reproduced completion_time_passed and completion_input_tick
definitions.T_incomplete[a][s]: total targets over the final stochastic episodes that are not verified clears, divided by their count (the 'incomplete-run targets'; reported)
definitions.left entry(e): btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry is not null (a live step with position_x < -2100)
definitions.deterministic collapse: M7e definition on the final deterministic play: collapse_share = longest run of one joint action / episode length; collapsed iff collapse_share >= 1/2

gates.name: integrity
any_of: the control check (R1 reproduction, R2 re-evaluation, R3 recomputed decision inputs) has not passed for the frozen campaign code, or a historical control file changed since the manifest

a T run is missing, stopped or not verified (training verification with every row equal to its btt_reward_v3_t2 closed form; fresh untrained model equal to the manifest digest; identity; the M7k control-equivalence checks V1-V5 against the historical control run)
the evaluation census of a T run is incomplete (985 episodes per run) or an evaluation label failed verification (tick-0 starts, clean metrics, frozen statistics, route-row closed forms)
a native clear whose clear verification did not run or did not reproduce both clocks

conditions.1a: #{s : gain[s] >= gain_min_episodes} >= gain_seeds_min, i.e. at least +5 episodes (5 percentage points) in at least 2 of the 3 seeds
conditions.1b: P[T] >= pooled_ratio_min * P[C], evaluated as sum_s t2[T][s] >= 3 * sum_s t2[C][s] (a zero control rate makes 1b hold trivially; 1a still requires the gains)

gates.name: no_static_loss
gates.condition: Sbar[T] - Sbar[C] >= -static_loss_max_per_episode, i.e. sum over T's 300 episodes of static(e) >= sum over C's 300 of static(e) - 150; a loss of exactly 1/2 per episode passes

gates.name: first_clear_relevance
gates.condition: R[T][s] >= 1 in at least 1 seed, or L[T][0] + L[T][1] + L[T][2] >= 5 (of 300)
gates.note: applied only after gates 1 and 2 hold; L and R measure relevance to a first clear, never a crossing or a clear

primary_rule: gates 1 and 2 (after gate 0): the target-2 break rate rose by at least 5 points in at least 2 seeds and to at least 3x the pooled control rate, without losing more than 0.5 static targets per episode

no_decision.response: no decision; report the integrity problems

not_learned.response: gate 1 failed: within this budget the credit did not overcome the exploration gap (near misses ~0 in M7k). Next is an exploration mechanism: a user decision

learned_with_static_loss.response: target 2 learned at a cost of more than 0.5 static targets per episode: not adopted; report; next step a user decision
learned_with_static_loss.claims: a target-2 gain with a static-target trade-off; not a crossing or a clear

learned_not_early.response: primary rule holds but the first-clear relevance test fails: target 2 learned but not early or not together with the static targets. Next: right-side timing (the even credit, btt_reward_v3_rt) as a separately registered follow-up (user decision)
learned_not_early.claims: a target-2 break-rate gain only; not a crossing, a sweep in time or a clear

first_clear_relevant.response: primary rule and relevance hold. Next: the crossing stage, with the landing penalty (btt_reward_v3_l2) registered as its own contract (user decision)
first_clear_relevant.claims: early target 2 together with the statics (L) or early sweeps (R); still not a crossing or a clear unless verified clears or left entries are reported separately

recorded_separately: per seed and arm: t2, p, gain, L, R, the target-2 break ticks (all, median, by the deadline) and falls after a target-2 break
T_incomplete (incomplete-run targets), Sbar and the six-right static mean
verified clears (all T evaluation labels, 2,955 episodes; the control's registered labels), native clear candidates and their verification
left-region entries, left-target breaks (per ID), falls
deterministic play: targets, t2, L, R, collapse share and whether collapsed
the target-2 learning curve (every evaluated checkpoint) and target-2 events during training (credited rows)

the approach-zone visit rate (x 2,100..3,300, y >= 1,350 while live), the closest approach to target 2 and platform contact, from exact spatial replays of every final stochastic episode of both arms (secondary, descriptive)
throughput, wall time, memory and process counts

known_control_values.source: runs/m7g_k/_eval/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1/final (registered Phase K evaluations), computed with rl/m7l_analysis.label_inputs before registration; the control check (R3) must reproduce them from the R2 re-evaluation and from the historical files

implied_thresholds.gate_2: sum over T's 300 episodes of static(e) >= 1221
implied_thresholds.gate_1a: t2[T][s] >= 6 / 5 / 7 for seeds 0 / 1 / 2, in at least 2 seeds

prediction_on_record: M7k section 10: uncertain. Encounters are rare (0.77 % of training episodes, about 5-9 per run at the control's rates, more frequent early when v2 teaches avoidance); the credit changes the sign of the learning signal but cannot create visits to a region the policy does not reach
not_claims: a target-2 gain alone is never described as a crossing, a left-side result or a clear; clears count only when verified natively
